%%{init: {'sequence': {'mirrorActors': false}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
  title Worker Job Lifecycle
  participant Client
  participant Scheduler
  participant Queue
  Client->>Scheduler: Submit job
  create participant Worker
  Scheduler->>Worker: Spawn worker
  loop Poll tasks (3x)
    Worker->>Queue: Fetch next task
    opt Task available
      Queue-->>Worker: Task payload
      Worker->>Worker: Execute job
    end
  end
  destroy Worker
  Worker-->>Scheduler: Completed & exit
  Scheduler-->>Client: Job finished
